title: [Accommodation - Location Picker (Korea)] Submitting Bid Request Fails With HTTP 400 INVALID_DISTRICT_CODE / INVALID_CITY_CODE Due to Shifted Administrative Levels
steps_to_reproduce: Sign in at https://web.stag.goodnstay.com/en-US/home (redirects to https://web.stag.goodnstay.com/en-US/accommodation) using an approved Traveler test account (baominh.internship@gmail.com).

In section '1/3 Your stay', select Country = 'Republic of Korea (한국)', Province or metropolitan city = 'Gyeonggi (경기도)', City or county = 'Gapyeong-gun (가평군)', and in the 3rd sub-location dropdown (dynamically labeled 'Eup, myeon, or dong') select 'Gapyeong-eup (가평읍)'.

Fill in section '2/3 Request overview' (Check-in: 2026-11-17, Check-out: 2026-11-19, 2 guests, 1 room) and section '3/3 What kind of accommodation would you like to use?' (Accommodation type = Hotel, Room type = Standard).
Click 'REQUEST A BID', click 'REQUEST A BID' again inside the confirmation modal, and inspect POST https://services.stag.goodnstay.com/api/traveler/request-bids in F12 Network.

Repeat with a Korean metropolitan city that skips the city (시·군) level: select Province or metropolitan city = 'Seoul (서울특별시)' -> District = 'Gangnam-gu (강남구)' -> Eup, myeon, or dong = 'Gaepo 1-dong (개포1동)' (or select 'Gangnam-gu' from 'Search destination' autocomplete) and submit.
actual_result:
- Case 1 (Province city/county without district '구', e.g., Gyeonggi -> Gapyeong-gun -> Gapyeong-eup): GET /api/locations/children?country=KR&parentId=KR-41-GAPYEONG returns items with level='ward' (value='KR-41-GAPYEONG-GAPYEONG', hierarchyCode='KR_EUPMYEONDONG'). LocationPicker dynamically changes the 3rd input's label to 'Eup, myeon, or dong', renders 'District: Gapyeong-eup (가평읍)' in the right-side summary panel, and sends stayingDistrict='KR-41-GAPYEONG-GAPYEONG' with stayingWard=''. POST /api/traveler/request-bids fails with HTTP 400 Bad Request: {"success":false,"error":{"code":400,"message":{"code":"INVALID_DISTRICT_CODE","message":"Invalid district code."},"details":[]}}, displaying 'Invalid district code.' above 'Something went wrong'.
- Case 2 (Metropolitan/Special city without city '시·군', e.g., Seoul -> Gangnam-gu -> Gaepo 1-dong, or via 'Search destination' autocomplete): GET /api/locations/children?country=KR&parentId=KR-11 returns items with level='district' ('KR-11-GANGNAM'). LocationPicker shifts levels up by one slot, sending stayingCity='KR-11-GANGNAM' and stayingDistrict='KR-11-GANGNAM-GAEPO1' (stayingWard=''). POST /api/traveler/request-bids fails with HTTP 400 Bad Request: {"success":false,"error":{"code":400,"message":{"code":"INVALID_CITY_CODE","message":"Invalid city code."},"details":[]}}.
- Additionally, the pre-submit 'Request overview' confirmation modal displays '-' for City, District, and Ward.
expected_result:
- LocationPicker must bind selected administrative options to stayingProvince, stayingCity, stayingDistrict, and stayingWard strictly according to each option's returned level ('state' | 'city' | 'district' | 'ward') from /api/locations/children rather than dropdown slot index:
  1) For Gyeonggi -> Gapyeong-gun -> Gapyeong-eup (no district '구' level): payload must send stayingProvince='KR-41', stayingCity='KR-41-GAPYEONG', stayingDistrict='', stayingWard='KR-41-GAPYEONG-GAPYEONG'.
  2) For Seoul -> Gangnam-gu -> Gaepo 1-dong (no city '시·군' level): payload must send stayingProvince='KR-11', stayingCity='', stayingDistrict='KR-11-GANGNAM', stayingWard='KR-11-GANGNAM-GAEPO1' (or Backend/Frontend contract must agree on skipped intermediate levels).
- Submitting a room bid request for any valid South Korea destination must succeed with HTTP 200 OK.

evidence.console: AxiosError: Request failed with status code 400 on POST https://services.stag.goodnstay.com/api/traveler/request-bids; UI form displays red error message 'Invalid district code.' (Case 1) / 'Invalid city code.' (Case 2) and submit button changes to 'Something went wrong'.
evidence.network: 1) GET https://services.stag.goodnstay.com/api/locations/children?country=KR&parentId=KR-41-GAPYEONG -> 200 OK (returns value='KR-41-GAPYEONG-GAPYEONG', level='ward', hierarchyCode='KR_EUPMYEONDONG'). 2) POST https://services.stag.goodnstay.com/api/traveler/request-bids with payload {"data":{"stayingCountry":"KR","stayingProvince":"KR-41","stayingCity":"KR-41-GAPYEONG","stayingDistrict":"KR-41-GAPYEONG-GAPYEONG","stayingWard":"","checkInDate":"2026-11-17","checkOutDate":"2026-11-19","guestCount":2,"roomCount":1,"accommodationType":"hotel","roomTypes":["standard"]}} -> 400 Bad Request (x-powered-by: Strapi, server: istio-envoy) {"success":false,"error":{"code":400,"message":{"code":"INVALID_DISTRICT_CODE","message":"Invalid district code."},"details":[]}}. 3) Control check: leaving the 3rd dropdown empty (stayingCity='KR-42-GANGNEUNG', stayingDistrict='', stayingWard='') -> 200 OK (requestId: 1466, code: CRQ-K_FGKJIM).
evidence.notes: Root Cause (Frontend LocationPicker Slot-Shifting in /_next/static/chunks/3bxda6md1t62a.js module 960337 & helper module 25905 in /_next/static/chunks/2bk-g9pri3x93.js): KR's country hierarchy declares all 4 levels [state, city, district, ward], so c(eb.hierarchy, 'district') and c(eb.hierarchy, 'city') are always true. However, most Korean 시/군 cities/counties have no 구 (district) and jump directly from city to ward (읍·면·동), while metropolitan cities (특별시/광역시 like Seoul KR-11, Busan KR-26) have no 시·군 (city) and jump from state to district (구). Helper m.a(children, parentCode, stateCode) filters only by string prefix child.value.startsWith(parentCode + '-') without checking child.level, so input#district binds level='ward' items into valueDistrict -> stayingDistrict (module 269624 in 2zugsv847-164.js), triggering Strapi's level validation 400 INVALID_DISTRICT_CODE (and input#city binds level='district' items in Seoul, triggering 400 INVALID_CITY_CODE).

classification: Confirmed Bug — Korea Location Hierarchy Slot-Shifting Causes HTTP 400 Bid Request Submission Failure
reproducibility: Always (100% — 5/5 attempts across Korean non-districted cities/counties and metropolitan cities)
